title: Support JSON search providers with bounded explicit mirror fallback
description:
Fork research: parallel GPT-6 Astra source reviews, 2026-10-25. Current application baseline: 3ae404b.

## Purpose and evidence

makrron adds actual typed HTML/JSON providers, nested JSON extraction and configured mirrors. Current search is HTML-only. This is an extension to existing search, not a request to add search anew. Fork code includes unbounded body reads and hardcoded tracker injection; reuse the concept, not those behaviors.

## Acceptance criteria

- Preserve HTML search and item resolution while adding an explicit JSON provider type and bounded nested-field extraction into the existing normalized result contract.
- Use only operator-configured mirrors with capped attempts under one request-wide deadline, shared destination policy, cancellation, decoded-byte/result limits and clear failure-versus-empty semantics.
- Resolve relative links on the actual successful mirror origin, not the primary provider URL as Omni currently assumes. Validate hashes, magnet/torrent/provider URLs and reject javascript/data/file schemes; do not insert arbitrary trackers.
- Validate provider configuration atomically and retain last-known-good settings after invalid refreshes. Keep provider credentials/headers server-side; sync only safe UI descriptors, never raw secret-bearing endpoint objects.
- Test nested/array JSON, malformed and oversized data, primary failure/fallback success, cancellation/attempt limits, relative paths on alternate origins, unsafe schemes and failed refreshes with controlled servers.

## Scope

Implement within the existing Go engine, typed API, generated frontend models and authenticated handler chain. Use isolated legal fixtures; never test against live downloads. This is a new backlog item, not a claim that the proposed behavior already exists.
